body:
_Original comment by_ **Claudiu Popa (BitBucket: [PCManticore](http://bitbucket.org/PCManticore), GitHub: @PCManticore)**:

---

Fix another false positives with 'undefined-variable', where the variable can be found as a class assignment and used in a function annotation. Closes issue #342.

_Original comment by_ **Antony Lee (BitBucket: [anntzer](http://bitbucket.org/anntzer), GitHub: @anntzer?)**:

---

A similar issue happens when the class variable is the default value of a keyword-only argument, e.g.

```
class C:
    foo = 1
    def meth(self, *, arg=foo): pass
```

Reopening the same issue as they are really similar...

_Original comment by_ **Claudiu Popa (BitBucket: [PCManticore](http://bitbucket.org/PCManticore), GitHub: @PCManticore)**:

---

Detect undefined-variables in function default arguments.

This patch improves the detection of undefined variables and variables used before
assignment for variables used as default arguments to function,
where the variable was first defined in the class scope.
Closes issue #342.

_Original comment by_ **Tom Dryer (BitBucket: [tdryer](http://bitbucket.org/tdryer), GitHub: @tdryer?)**:

---

There's still a very similar issue with lambdas:

```
#!python

class C:
    foo = 1
    bar = lambda: C.foo
```

```
#!
E:  3,18: Undefined variable 'C' (undefined-variable)
```

_Original comment by_ **Claudiu Popa (BitBucket: [PCManticore](http://bitbucket.org/PCManticore), GitHub: @PCManticore)**:

---

Thanks, I'll open a  new issue for this. It's better to open a new issue when encountering a bug that was previously solved, since I tend to forget to look at them if there's no opened issue to keep track of it.

issue.body:
Originally reported by: **Florian Bruhin (BitBucket: [The-Compiler](http://bitbucket.org/The-Compiler), GitHub: @The-Compiler?)**

---

With this example code:

```
#!python

def dec(inp):
    def inner(func):
        print(inp)
        return func
    return inner


class Cls:

    DATA = "foo"

    @dec([x for x in DATA])
    def fun(self):
        pass
```

I get `E: 12,21: Undefined variable 'DATA' (undefined-variable)` even though the code is working fine.

pylint 1.4.3, 
astroid 1.3.6, common 0.63.2
